newsitem.title: USA: Winners All buys Designer Wear Inc.
newsitem.headline: Winners All buys Designer Wear Inc.

text.p: Winners All International Inc said Tuesday it has bought Designer Wear Inc in a stock deal.

Winners All said it will acquire all 2.15 million shares of privately held Designer Wear stock in exchange for about 5.38 million shares of Winners All stock. Winners All has about 24.8 million shares outstanding.
Designer Wear president Howard Weiser also becomes a director and officer of Winners All under the deal, Winners All said.

The company said Designer Wear has the worldwide license to use the likeness of James Dean on socks. It also has a 49 percent interest in a joint venture with RDK International Inc for the worldwide promotion of the Smith & Wesson trademark on clothing and accessories.
Winners all said it is in the process of buying privately owned RDK International, which has the worldwide license to use the Smith & Wesson trademark.
